Runtime fact list is explicit: task/instruction.md:9 says /app, 'node /app/server.js', port 3000 honoring PORT, GET /api/health without database work, /app/app.db honoring DB_PATH, UI/API in one process, and /assets/seed_data.json. instruction.md:13 requires copying runtime assets, delivery without a test database, seed-once startup and retained data after restart. environment/instructions/integration.md:3-10 supplies Node 22, Express/better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH, 0.0.0.0 and health-before-database startup; :16-19 documents the symlink policy enforced by test.sh. hireops_rules.md:60-68 states reference 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z and distinguishes referral reference time from the supplied rescission effective date. instruction.md:15 supplies all seven emails, password and roles; hireops_rules.md:43-46 requires visible approver tier. These agree with seed_data.json, tests/app_context.md and the inspected test.sh launch/liveness assumptions. Template integration.md uses the same core launch/storage contract.

I read all 108 criterion descriptions (1 render, 1 constraints, 86 functional, 14 polish, 6 visual) and their injected protocols/context. The public mapping is substantive: instruction.md:1-5 and :13 support real server-backed sign-in, six screens, accessible keyboard/mobile operation, visual craft, theme persistence, recoverable forms and loading/empty/failure states. hireops_rules.md:23-46 supplies roles; :70-100 supplies exact integer inputs, safe range and imported roster; sections 2-4 supply formulas, thresholds and ledger headroom; section 5 supplies arbitrary preserved IDs, creation, two-generation revisions, signed adjustments, replacement grants, relocation exclusion and atomic stale/concurrent refusal; sections 6-7 supply precise UTC dates, millisecond anniversaries, differing vesting schedules and referral split/cliff; section 8 explicitly supplies ignored claimed* body fields, 401/403, immutable readable audits/structured receipts; section 9 supplies visible figures and dashboard totals. Thus exact-money, unusual-ID, concurrency and request-claim probes exercise public rules rather than undisclosed output contracts.

Adversarial source checks: a plausible app using the host clock or offer-start date for referral retention conflicts with rules:60-68 and :346-365 and is distinguished by hro_referral_clock at functional/judge.toml:524. A static seed dashboard or browser-only mutations cannot satisfy constraints/judge.toml's fresh independently authenticated requisition/offer readback. A conforming alternative with different route names, generated IDs, dollar-valued requests, native date controls, vertically stacked compensation details and nonmodal forms remains allowed: rules:54-56 leaves routes/fields/layout open; functional/judge.toml:137 accepts stacked/scrollable details, :191 accepts public money representations, and functional/prompt.md explicitly prohibits assumed routes/schema. No row-04 hidden deliverable or missing runtime fact was established.

This is a source-contract verdict, not an app execution, private deterministic checker run, full configured judge run, Oracle/model score or portal clearance. No runtime artifact is cited to establish this row.
